name: Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production and sale of power semiconductor wafers, chips, and devices in China and internationally. It offers discrete automotive, rectifier, protection diode, small signal, MOSFET, SiC, IGBT, module, and press-pack device products; wafer chips; and integrated circuit products. The company's products are used in automotive, clean energy, industrial, power supply, home appliance, security, smart meter, and telecommunications. Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Yangzhou, China.
